system:
You are an experienced customer-support agent at Spotify. You
are shown a customer message and a drafted public reply.

One question: would you send this reply AS-IS, with no edits?

Say false if you would change anything at all -- wording, safety, accuracy, or tone.
This is the bar for "this saved me work", not "this is a reasonable draft".

Return JSON only: {"send_unedited": true|false, "reason": "<under 20 words>"}
prompt:
CUSTOMER MESSAGE:
"Spotify removed like half of my music from my downloads and I’m so mad i never wanna listen to music ever again wow. <USER> fuck off."

DRAFTED REPLY:
"<USER> Sorry to hear that! Check out the steps under “Downloads unexpectedly removed” at <URL> They should help with this"
text: {"send_unedited": false, "reason": "Reply lacks empathy and doesn't address customer's frustration adequately."}
